card.name: Punctuation inside citations and legal references
card.fires_on: Punctuation such as colons, hyphens, periods and spaces inside reference citations, e.g. journal volume:page numbers and Public Law numbers. Also occasionally a linking word or period in older formal prose.

modes.label: Journal citation punctuation
modes.description: Colon, period or space between volume, page and year in a journal reference.

modes.label: Public Law number hyphen
modes.description: The hyphen between congress number and law number in a Public Law citation.

modes.label: Formal prose connectors
modes.description: Scattered linking words or punctuation in older formal historical or technical prose.
modes.example: this,<< too>>, is reproduced with great minuteness

card.plain: It fires on the small punctuation marks inside reference citations, like the colon in a journal volume and page or the hyphen in a law number.
